title: useSearchParams - Returns
text_content:
`` returns a read-only version of the [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams) interface, which includes utility methods for reading the URL's query string:
[https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/get](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/get): Returns the first value associated with the search parameter. For example:```````````````` - use [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll) to get all values
[https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/has](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/has): Returns a boolean value indicating if the given parameter exists. For example:````````
Learn more about other read-only methods of [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams), including the [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll), [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/keys](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/keys), [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/values](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/values), [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/entries](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/entries), [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/forEach](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/forEach), and [https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/toString](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/toString).

title: useSearchParams - Static Rendering

This allows a part of the route to be statically rendered while the dynamic part that uses `` is client-side rendered.

title: useSearchParams - Layouts
text_content:
Unlike Pages, [/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout) (Server Components) do not receive the `` prop. This is because a shared layout is [/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/linking-and-navigating#4-partial-rendering](/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/linking-and-navigating#4-partial-rendering) which could lead to stale `` between navigations. View [/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout#layouts-do-not-receive-searchparams](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout#layouts-do-not-receive-searchparams).
Instead, use the Page [/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page) prop or the [/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-search-params](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-search-params) hook in a Client Component, which is re-rendered on the client with the latest ``.
